100% Brazilian Remy Human Hair

Professionally custom colored by Mia Kelly in a Level 7 base with 7-8 subtle highlights, creating a rich, dimensional blend with beautifully placed highlights and natural depth for a soft, dimensional finish. 

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
